plan: My value is $24. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Assume others bid near their value, around $24. I'll bid $22 to outbid those valuing slightly less and still profit if I win, as the third-highest bid will likely be lower. This balances winning chances and profit margin.

Given my value of $9, bidding above this would result in a loss if I win, as I would pay more than the item's value to me. I aim to bid slightly above half my value to maximize potential profit if others bid low. A bid of $5 should balance the risk of losing with the cost of winning at a low third-highest bid.

Given my value of $13, I should bid conservatively to ensure profit if I win. Assuming others bid close to their values, I will bid slightly below my value to avoid overpaying. A bid of $12.5 is strategic: if others bid low, I win and pay less than my value, ensuring profit. If others bid higher, I lose but incur no cost.
